summary.intent: Finish a batch of follow-up fixes to an interactive selection prompt (tty.rs in callisto-cli) for a PR, then, after user pushback that the UI wording was too verbose, simplify the hints and selection syntax.
summary.outcome: Assistant agreed the per-prompt '#2 always means row 2' hint was over-documenting an edge case, removed the `#N` syntax, restored short hints, and made the numeric-name collision case produce a names-only message shown only when it occurs. Edits were applied to tty.rs and unit tests, full gate and commit were run, though results are not shown in the transcript.

repo: Work happens in a git worktree at /Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/.claude/worktrees/wp-add-inquire (branch for the 'add inquire' work).
Verification workflow is unit tests (224) plus pty tests (33) plus a 'full gate' before pushing; one push per PR.
Qualified package names always contain `/` (e.g. `npm/1`), so they can never collide with numeric row selections.

code.finding: choices() and numbered() hold the selection parsing, hint text, and row error formatting; the `#N` syntax was removed and the collision error now asks for a name only. Exact line numbers were not given in the transcript.

workflow: Prefer minimal UX text: do not document rare edge cases in every prompt; surface explanation only when the edge case actually occurs.
Resolving an ambiguity by removing a syntax feature is better than adding syntax plus explanatory text.
Committed work was held unpushed while full-history sweeps ran, so findings could be batched into the same push.
